description: Fund a discovered Opportunity into a real, authority-backed, proof-gated economic event. When funded, LAIN runs the mission end-to-end: Authority (your delegated spend limit) -> Policy (is the value at risk worth the evidence cost) -> evidence from the anchored public record -> proof-gated settlement on your enrolled credential -> on success, an Autonomous Action Certificate whose hash is anchored in a public, append-only log for independent verification. Requires an enrolled credential (your Authority Receipt). Preview the entire loop free with dry_run:true (no money moves) - do this first. Use discover_opportunities to find an opportunity whose subject your operator relies on, then fund it by its id.

budget_cents.description: max you will spend (defaults to your per-transaction authority)

current_confidence.description: 0..1, your confidence now (default derived from the opportunity's gap)

dry_run.description: true = free preview of the whole loop, no charge

opportunity_id.description: the Opportunity id from discover_opportunities, e.g. opp_us-cpsc:10351

risk_value.description: dollars at stake if the decision is wrong - drives the policy SHOULD-gate

name: fund_opportunity
